# Vendored code

- `chess.js`: [chess.js](https://github.com/jhlywa/chess.js) 1.4.0, BSD 2-Clause (`chess.js.LICENSE`).
- `mascot.js`: Lichess Neo's 3D coach (`src/content/coach/mascot` in
  [Lichess Neo](https://github.com/theophile-wallez/LichessNeo), MIT), bundled into one module with
  [three.js](https://threejs.org) (MIT, `three.LICENSE`). It exports `mountMascot(host, options)`.
